questions.question: What does Nahum 3 call Nineveh?
options: The golden city of merchants and kings
The holy city, where the LORD dwells
The peaceful city of refuge and rest
The bloody city, full of lies and plunder
questions.answer: The bloody city, full of lies and plunder

questions.question: How will people react to Nineveh's fall, according to Nahum 3?
options: All who pass by her will mourn and weep aloud over her very sudden downfall
All who hear will clap their hands, for who has not felt her endless evil?
The many peoples will fall wholly silent, in fear of the very same fate themselves
The surrounding nations will hasten to rebuild her broken-down walls and gates
questions.answer: All who hear will clap their hands, for who has not felt her endless evil?

questions.question: Nahum 3 compares Nineveh's downfall to that of Thebes (No-amon), which also fell.
Woe to the bloody _____, all full of lies and plunder!
